trucks.correctionNote: The 26-08 report published 46 truck moves. Five of those are the same trucks counted twice across the Sunday to Monday boundary: four vacuum trucks were loaded with slops on 23.08 (E21) and dispatched on 24.08 (E25), and one truck was loaded with mud skips on 23.08 (E23) and dispatched on 24.08 (E26). The report's own prose repeats the error, calling them 8 vacuum-truck loads and 6 full mud skips where the workbook records 4 trucks and 3 skips. Counted once each, the week made 41 moves, which is what this dashboard shows.

highlights: OD1 completed the wellhead N/D and the 30" corrosion cap installation. The rig is preparing to move to new well BOUM-0001.
Overstay crew rose to 13 (HLB 2, COSL 11) from nil the week before. Contractor demobilisation needs follow up with COSL.
Lower vessel and truck activity follows OPH being off-hired, one active rig against two the week before, not a reduction in service level.
CA1 carried the bulk and cargo programme across 4 trips, including a 52 lift peak offload at Shuaiba on Sat 22.
Charlie-3 handled all crew changes across 5 trips, including 14 Pax via MM Port on Sat 22, and an 18 in / 8 out change at OD1.
Ground activity peaked on Tue 25 with 9 dispatches, driven by OPH demobilisation: batch mixers, an 18-3/4" annular BOP and DP backloads to COSL Mina Abdallah.

4 vacuum trucks of 9.0 ppg contaminated slops went to MG-0348 and 3 full mud skips to the NCC SEK plant, loaded Sun 23 and dispatched Mon 24, with no HSE incident. CA1 also transferred 320 bbl of slops to vacuum tankers at Shuaiba.
dataNotes: The 26-08 report published 46 truck moves. Counted once each, the week made 41: four vacuum trucks and one mud-skip truck were loaded on 23.08 and dispatched on 24.08, and both events were counted. The report's prose repeats it as 8 vacuum-truck loads and 6 full mud skips.
The 26-08 report drew its arrows against 06 to 12 Aug 2026, skipping the week 13 to 19 Aug. The gap is in the report, not in this dashboard.
Port sheet Status reads Not Normal on all 6 days. Vessel sheet Status reads Normal on all 6 days. The only recurring port exception recorded is no night shift operation.
